title: Integral closure in a finite product of normal domains has normal localizations
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be commutative rings and let $B$ be an $A$-algebra. Let $I$ be a finite index set and let $C_i$ be integrally closed domains [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Suppose that $B\cong\prod_{i\in I} C_i$ as rings. Put $D=\overline A^{\,B}$, the integral closure of $A$ in $B$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset D$, the ring $D_{\mathfrak p}$ is an integrally closed domain. No injectivity of $A\to B$ is assumed; the empty product is included.

proof.text: Use the ring equivalence to equip each C_i with its induced A-algebra structure. Projection sends an integral tuple to integral coordinates. Conversely, choose a monic annihilating polynomial over A for each integral coordinate and multiply these finitely many polynomials. Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic and aeval_pi_apply₂ show that this monic product annihilates the tuple. This also covers the empty product. Thus coordinate projection gives a bijective ring homomorphism D -> product_i integralClosure A C_i.

Each coordinate integral closure D_i is a domain as a subring of the domain C_i. Mathlib IsIntegrallyClosed.of_isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosedIn makes D_i integrally closed because C_i is a normal domain and an integral closure is integrally closed in its ambient ring. Its prime localizations remain normal domains by isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization and the domain localization instance.

Apply the proved Pi.isNormalRing_of_finite [lem-weil-pbc-finite-product-normal] to the D_i. Map p across the ring equivalence from step 1 and use Localization.localRingEquiv to identify its localization with the localization of that product. Transport IsDomain and IsIntegrallyClosed across this equivalence.

theorem integralClosure_normal_localizations_of_finite_product
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]
    {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] (C : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (C i)]
    [∀ i, IsDomain (C i)] [∀ i, IsIntegrallyClosed (C i)]
    (e : B ≃+* ∀ i, C i) (p : Ideal (integralClosure A B)) [p.IsPrime] :
    IsDomain (Localization.AtPrime p) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (Localization.AtPrime p)
